verdict.rationale: Gusto's own docs show recurring scheduling only inside payroll: it pre-generates regular payrolls from a company's pay schedule, supports different pay schedules, and the CLI exposes a pay-schedule command. This is domain-specific recurrence, not a general scheduler for arbitrary jobs or workflows, and the pre-generated payrolls still have to be completed rather than running automatically. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary recurring jobs/workflows, documented API for defining custom recurrence (cron-style), unattended automatic execution of scheduled runs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: We automatically pre-generate scheduled regular payrolls based on the company’s pay schedule and corresponding pay periods.
They might want everyone paid at the same time, or prefer different pay schedules based on location or job type.
gusto timesheet, gusto payroll, gusto pay-schedule
